column1: # Русский (ru) interface catalog for Sintec.PDF: its own strings and its overrides of common.tsv.
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  usually empty. `@plural`, `@id` and `@msg` mean something to the app; any other
#            word is a label that tells apart two meanings of the same English.
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns (in any
#            order), and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   @plural  English `one|other`; the translation lists the Russian forms one|few|many, `|`-separated.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Based on the craft-i18n catalog (storytold/craft-i18n at 575cfdef, MIT OR Apache-2.0) and
# Sintec.PDF's own Russian catalog; Sintec.PDF's wording wins where the two differ.
# Terminology: annotations are "комментарии", redaction is "скрытие", form fields are "поля формы",
# tags are "теги". Product and format names (Sintec.PDF, PDF, Word, HTML…) stay in Latin letters.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No other product's localisation, string table or translated UI was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
